map.液肥稀释ppm计算器 使用指南: Liquid fertilizer dilution ppm calculator - user guide
map.液肥稀释 ppm 计算器。输入目标浓度（ppm）与水量，计算所需肥料用量，或反算: Liquid fertilizer dilution ppm calculator. Enter target concentration (ppm) and water volume to compute the required fertilizer amount, or back-calculate the diluted ppm, for precise fertilization in soilless culture and hydroponics.
map.求用量模式：已知目标浓度（ppm）、水量（L）与肥料养分含量（%），肥料用量(g: Dosage mode: given target concentration (ppm), water volume (L), and fertilizer nutrient content (%), fertilizer amount (g) = target ppm x water volume / (nutrient content / 100) / 1000000 x 1000; the tool shows the result in both g and ml (dilute liquid fertilizer density approximated as water).
map.反算浓度模式：已知实际肥料用量(g)、水量与养分含量，浓度 ppm=用量×(养分: Back-calculate concentration mode: given actual fertilizer amount (g), water and nutrient content, concentration ppm = amount*(nutrient content/100)*1000000/water/1000, to check whether prepared nutrient solution is excessive or insufficient.
map.配套换算：稀释倍数=水量(L)×1000÷用量(g)（一份肥兑多少份水），约滴数: Companion conversions: dilution factor = water volume (L) x 1000 / amount (g) (how many parts water per part fertilizer), approx drops = amount (ml) / 0.05 (est. 0.05 ml/drop), so you can dose by drops without a scale; all three are given with the main result and can be screenshotted as a mixing card.
map.算例：目标 200 ppm、1 L 水、养分含量 20%: Example: target 200 ppm, 1 L water, nutrient content 20%
map.：求用量：200×1÷0.2÷1000000×1000=1 g（等于 1 ml）: : dosage: 200 x 1 / 0.2 / 1000000 x 1000 = 1 g (equals 1 ml); dilution factor = 1 x 1000 / 1 = 1000 x; approx drops = 1 / 0.05 = 20 drops. Water change and concentration: 150 ppm / 10 L / 20% -> 7.5 g, 1333 x, 150 drops; 100 ppm / 20 L / 15% -> 13.333 g, 1500 x, 267 drops. Reverse check: 1 g / 1 L / 20% -> 200 ppm; 7.5 g / 10 L / 20% -> 150 ppm, consistent with the forward result.
map.ppm 到底是什么意思，为什么 200 ppm 的 1 L 水只要 1 g 肥？: What does ppm really mean, and why does 1 L of 200 ppm water need only 1 g fertilizer?
map.ppm 在水中等于 mg/L，1 ppm 即每升水含 1 mg 有效养分。200: In water ppm equals mg/L; 1 ppm means 1 mg active nutrient per liter. 1 L of 200 ppm water needs 200 mg active nutrient; if the fertilizer element content is 20%, fertilizer needed is 200/0.2 = 1000 mg = 1 g. So larger 'target concentration x water amount' means more usage, higher 'nutrient content' means less usage; the three are in direct/inverse proportion.
map.养分含量那一栏该填什么数字？: What number to fill in the nutrient content field?
map.应填肥料标签上对应元素或氧化物的含量（氮 N、或 P₂O₅、K₂O 的百分比），: Fill the content of the corresponding element or oxide on the fertilizer label (nitrogen N, or P2O5, K2O percentage), not the sum of three nutrients. E.g. balanced 20-20-20, if by nitrogen fill 20; if formula is by P2O5, fill the corresponding P2O5 percentage. Wrong fill makes the amount a fraction or multiple of actual need; check label before preparing.
